transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough that just won't go away. I've had it about three weeks now, ever since I had a cold, and it's not clearing up.
When did you first notice it?
It started about three weeks ago, right after I had a cold. The cold itself went, but the cough stayed.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Cold air sets it off, and if I talk for a long time it starts up as well. Steam inhalation seems to help a little.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
I'm bringing up phlegm, a white-to-yellow colour, and there's more of it than my usual morning phlegm.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's in my chest, that's where it comes from when I cough. It doesn't spread anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'd say about a 6 out of 10. It's disturbing my sleep most nights, which is the worst part of it.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes. It's worst in the morning and at night, and when I get a fit it lasts a few minutes.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
I've been a bit more breathless than usual when I walk to the shop. Otherwise, no coughing up blood, no weight loss, no night sweats and no chest pain.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got COPD — I've had that for about eight years now.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?

I use a blue salbutamol inhaler, and I've been needing that 4-5 times a day now instead of my usual twice. I also use a Fostair 100/6 inhaler, two puffs twice daily. And I take lisinopril 10 mg once a day for my blood pressure — I've been on that for several years.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I'm not allergic to any medicines that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I get a bit more breathless walking to the shop than I used to, so I've been slower at that. Nothing else has really changed around the house.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Yes, it does worry me. I'm concerned my lungs are getting worse, or that this could be something like cancer.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
